scope: Local post-review methods sensitivity and manuscript revision, not new confirmation
basis: Reviewer data already exposed; parent plans and thresholds unchanged
main: Replay complete original FIT001 RNG calls and retraining, 1900 allocations / 1000 fits / 400 pool pairs, evaluate generic and full-domain pair-range bounds on each same dataset
range: All finite input support and both binary outcomes; known pre-evaluation envelope. Outward rounding for elementary interval operations. Same interval bounds group averages, no 1/m narrowing
power_control: Original group engine at G=1024, theta=0 and .5; original lower-G cells labeled structurally unresolved; extract existing controls and add independent check
power_reference: Finite two-point risk-gap reference, exact binomial probability sums at fixed alpha/epsilon; not a model-moment bound presented as a power curve
acceptance: All original decision counts and levels match; range implementation agrees with direct differences; no prospective minimum-power requirement or preferred result; preserve failures
not_permitted: calling model-moment planning bounds impossibility bounds
